title: Which country speaks it officially: Africa
intro: Find a country in Africa that uses each language officially.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has French as an official language?
questions.explain: French is an official language of Algeria.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Xhosa as an official language?
questions.explain: Xhosa is an official language of South Africa.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Chichewa as an official language?
questions.explain: Chichewa is an official language of Malawi.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Somali as an official language?
questions.explain: Somali is an official language of Somalia.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Swati as an official language?
questions.explain: Swati is an official language of South Africa.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Arabic as an official language?
questions.explain: Arabic is an official language of Eritrea.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Venda as an official language?
questions.explain: Venda is an official language of South Africa.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Tswana as an official language?
questions.explain: Tswana is an official language of South Africa.
